replies.body:

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
It's too flat and narrow in my opinion, and the blocks used are somewhat distracting and not fit for looks either. While it's certainly different and creative from prior maps in Minotaur, one major flaw overlooked is that you can use the vines and climb up to the top, and avoid the entire map. Another flaw is that the webs are made to where you can leave the map (being the height of the player) instead of being a part of design.

Fixed YML: http://pastebin.com/QQ4aCfF6

Line 6: Indentation needed. Spartamex should be lined with "creators:" below.
Line 7: Unnecessary Coords. Try rounding them and using less numbers.

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Im sorry, But the judges for the map building contest "Chamaeleon" have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

- This map is too small in length and wouldn't last very long. To improve, please lengthen the course to enhance gameplay.

- In the Chamaeleon judges opinions, this map has minimal obstacles. The obstacles that are present on the map are few in quantity and aren't very challenging.



Aesthetics 3/5
Gameplay 1/5 
Creativity 1/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
